APPROVE
The extracted helpers keep the original logic, including the inverted candidate filter (`Raw ==` for the same rule, `Key == || Universal` otherwise), the `Print` skip, lazy `Analyse`, and returning true on the first matching declaration, while `Replaced` drops to about 4; I couldn't find the repository to build it, so the helper parameter types (`Rule`, `SelectorFacts`, `Decl`) are assumed to match the original signature rather than confirmed by a build.
